summary.en-US: Unofficial viewer for the pawchive.pw API

description.en-US:
PawKemoViewer is an unofficial viewer for the pawchive.pw API. It lets you
browse posts, creators, favorites, and follows from pawchive.pw on Android.

Features:
* Post lists with grid/list views and source filtering
* Creator search, profiles, post lists, and follows
* Post detail with content, images/videos, comments, and revisions
* Thumbnail-first loading and low-data mode
* Save selected images from posts, attachments, and external pages
  (personal use only)
* Backup, logs, Japanese/English UI, dark/light themes

The app does not collect personal information. It contains no analytics,
advertising, crash-reporting, or tracking SDKs. Settings, follows, favorites,
read state, session keys, and caches are stored only on the device.

This app is unofficial and is not affiliated with pawchive.pw or the content
providers. It is intended for users aged 18 or older and may display adult
content. Content rights belong to their respective owners; saving is limited
to personal use, and redistribution or commercial use is prohibited.

Using an unofficial client may result in restrictions on third-party
accounts. The app depends on the pawchive.pw service, which is not free
software and may change or stop without notice.
